biotools.summary: ONT-cappable-seq is a long-read microbial transcriptomics approach used to reveal the transcriptional architecture of bacteriophages infecting Pseudomonas aeruginosa. The tool maps transcription start and termination sites, units, and regulators and is made available through a GitHub repository.
